external_coverage.exact_statement: On a Euclidean quasi-embedded polyhedral space X, open U and common carrying complex Π, BBGS2022’s negative inward-unit-normal product accepts real PA functions and real weights, commutes with restriction/subdivision, and satisfies f·(g·c)=g·(f·c) for k-weights c, k≥2. Ambient-linear annihilation characterizes Minkowski weights, which restriction, subdivision and PA products preserve, including signed/zero weights (Definitions 3.1–3.9; Propositions 3.12/3.15/3.19; Lemma 3.18).

BMPS arXiv:2603.08664v1 uses finite globally embedded rational complexes, saturated tangent lattices Nσ=N∩span_R(σ−σ), rational cycle weights, primitive inward quotient normals, and continuous PA functions with integral tangent slopes and rational constants. Definitions 3.2–3.3 require rational PCC endpoints, allowing real centers and coefficients. Definition 2.31 and Definitions 4.4–4.7 use tangent-corrected d-fold primitive recursion without an additional factorial. Definition 3.23 defines uniform relative PA regularization; Definition 4.15 requires positive nonzero recession slopes. For a PA PC reference positive at infinity and continuous obstacle, Definition 6.2 uses unrestricted PC minorants bounded above by γ+O(1); Definition 6.9 assumes pair-level regularity before orthogonality.

For a quasi-embedded polyhedral space with quasi-embedding ι and an open set U, BBGS2022 Definition 5.1 permits arbitrary endpoints xi∈U, nonnegative real coefficients summing to one and ι(x)=Σν_iι(xi). PCCs additionally require faces τ containing x and σ_i containing τ, with xi∈σ_i⊂U.
